verdict.rationale: Brex documents real-time transaction categorization, AI-driven memo writing, receipt fetching/matching, policy enforcement, and one-click accounting sync (Puzzle) that eliminate manual month-end reconciliation work, directly supporting continuous coding of spend as it happens. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that AI-drafted memos and receipt-matching are accurate enough in practice to avoid finance-team review, and no customer testimonial confirming close time reduction.
